🇯🇵 Japan 2023: Our First Winter Adventure Together ❄️
Travel Diaries | Japan, 2023
Tokyo • Disneyland • Mt. Fuji • GALA Yuzawa • Shinkansen

❄️ Our First Winter Experience in Japan

Japan has always been one of the countries I've dreamed of visiting, especially during winter. Coming from the Philippines, where we don't experience snow, I was so excited to finally see and feel it in person!
In 2023, Kevin and I traveled to Japan for our very first winter adventure together.
Everything felt new and exciting, from wearing layers of winter clothes to experiencing the cold weather and seeing beautiful snowy landscapes.
It was definitely a different experience from our previous travels, and that's what made it even more special.
🏙️ Exploring Tokyo: Getting Lost in the City
One of my favorite things about traveling is simply walking around and exploring unfamiliar places.
Tokyo was perfect for that!
We spent time strolling through the busy streets, admiring the buildings, discovering different shops, and experiencing the city's unique atmosphere.
One of the most memorable places we explored was Shibuya, especially the famous Shibuya Crossing.
Seeing hundreds of people crossing the intersection while surrounded by giant screens, colorful advertisements, and bright city lights was such an experience!
Tokyo was busy, but everything felt fascinating. Even just walking around without a specific destination was already an adventure.
🏰 A Magical Day at Tokyo Disneyland
Of course, we couldn't visit Japan without experiencing the magic of Tokyo Disneyland!
No matter how old we get, there's something about Disneyland that brings out our inner child.
From seeing the beautiful attractions to enjoying the magical atmosphere, it was one of the highlights of our trip.
Sharing this experience with Kevin made it even more memorable.
Traveling together means getting to experience things we've only seen in photos or videos, and Disneyland was definitely one of those places.
🗻 Seeing the Beautiful Mt. Fuji
Another highlight of our Japan adventure was visiting Mt. Fuji, one of the country's most iconic landmarks.
There's something special about seeing a place in person after admiring it in photographs for so long.
The scenery around Mt. Fuji was beautiful, and being surrounded by Japan's winter landscapes made the experience even more unforgettable.
It was one of those moments when you just want to stop, look around, and appreciate how lucky you are to experience something so beautiful.
Definitely another memory worth keeping. ❤️
⛄ GALA Yuzawa: Finally Experiencing Snow!
If there's one experience that made this trip extra special, it was visiting GALA Yuzawa Snow Resort!
Imagine coming from a tropical country and finally finding yourself surrounded by mountains covered in snow.
It felt surreal!

I was so happy to experience real snow for the first time. The cold weather, the beautiful white surroundings, and the excitement of finally being in a winter destination made everything feel magical.
We took photos, enjoyed the snowy scenery, and made the most of our time there.
Looking back at our photos, I can still remember how excited I was.
GALA Yuzawa will always be special to me because it was where one of my winter travel dreams finally came true. ❄️
🚄 Our First Shinkansen Experience
Another exciting first during our Japan trip was riding the famous Shinkansen, Japan's high-speed bullet train!
I've always been fascinated by Japan's transportation system, so getting to experience the Shinkansen was something I was really looking forward to.
The train was incredibly smooth, comfortable, and fast!
It was amazing how quickly we could travel between destinations while enjoying the beautiful scenery outside.
Although the Shinkansen isn't the fastest train in the world in every category, it's definitely one of the most famous high-speed railway systems.
Experiencing it for the first time was another highlight of our trip.
❤️ Traveling Together, Collecting Memories
Looking back at our Japan 2023 adventure, I realized that what made this trip truly special wasn't just the beautiful destinations.
It was experiencing so many firsts together.
Our first winter country. Our first time experiencing snow. Our first Shinkansen ride. And another opportunity to explore a beautiful part of the world.
From strolling through Tokyo's busy streets to enjoying the peaceful snowy landscapes of GALA Yuzawa, every experience became another memory we could share.
I love how traveling allows us to discover new places, experience different cultures, and create stories that we'll remember for years.
And I'm grateful that I get to experience these adventures with Kevin. ❤️
✈️ Japan, We'll Definitely Be Back!
Japan was everything I hoped it would be and more.
The beautiful scenery, fascinating culture, convenient transportation, and unforgettable winter experiences made it one of our most memorable trips.
This adventure also made me realize how much I love winter destinations.
There's just something magical about snow, cold weather, and exploring a completely different environment from what we're used to back home.
Our Japan 2023 trip may have ended, but the memories will always stay with us.
And one thing is certain: Japan is definitely a country I'd love to visit again!
Here's to more adventures, more winter destinations, and more beautiful memories together.
Japan 2023 — our first winter adventure, but definitely not our last. 🇯🇵❄️❤️
